description.value: Afra Bakery & Supermarket is a neighbourhood convenience store and bakery in North Vancouver combining grocery staples with baked goods. Its dual bakery-and-supermarket identity suggests a local, independent character that distinguishes it from chain convenience outlets. Touring cyclists moving through the North Shore corridor may find it a practical stop for resupply.
